statements.status_notes: The vulnerability is in click.edit(), which spawns an editor from an attacker-influenced command. Click 8.1.8 is only present in the Cassandra dev variant, pulled in as a transitive Python dist-package (the runtime variant ships no Python). No shipped tooling invokes click.edit(): cqlsh parses arguments with argparse and the bundled cassandra-driver does not call into Click. The advisory also requires local access with an attacker-controlled editor environment (CVSS AV:L/AC:H/PR:H/UI:R), and Debian marked it no-dsa.
